title: Xuanzhi Workflow Registry Entry
description: Structured registry entry for a governed workflow in the Xuanzhi workspace.

workflow_id.description: Globally unique identifier of the workflow within the workspace.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the workflow.

description.description: Compact governance-relevant description of the workflow.

workflow_type.description: Canonical governance-facing type of the workflow.

owner_type.description: Structured ownership class of the workflow.

trigger_types.description: Declared trigger surfaces for this workflow.

permissions.description: Declared permissions or control surfaces the workflow may touch or invoke.

resource_limits.description: Bounded resource posture of the workflow.

external_service_classes.description: Optional list of external service classes used by the workflow.

risk_level.description: Categorical risk class of the workflow under normal expected use.

risk_summary.description: Optional concise explanation of workflow risk posture.

approved.description: Whether this workflow has passed the required governance approval gate.

version.description: Declared version of the governed workflow definition.

definition_ref.description: Optional pointer to the authoritative workflow definition or implementation location.

health_status.description: Governance-facing health signal for the workflow.

lifecycle_state.description: Durable administrative lifecycle state of the workflow entry.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the registry entry was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the registry entry was last updated.

created_by.description: Actor that created the registry entry.

updated_by.description: Actor that last updated the registry entry.

approved_at.description: Optional timestamp when the workflow was approved.

approved_by.description: Optional actor that approved the workflow.

revoked_at.description: Optional timestamp when the workflow was revoked.

archived_at.description: Optional timestamp when the workflow was archived.

last_checked_at.description: Optional timestamp when workflow health was last checked.

then.description: A workflow must be approved before it may be active.
